text: Seeking endorsement of events for Municipal Significance for liquor licensing purposes.

North York Community Council: 1. Under its delegated authority under Chapter 27-152, Delegation to Community Councils, declared the following to be events of municipal significance, for liquor licensing purposes: a. the "Block Party Volleyball Tournament in Support of You Can Play" event to be held on Sunday, July 22, 2018 from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., at Beach Blast, 15 Leswyn Road; and b. the Sell Off Vacations "Grand Re-opening" event, to be held on Thursday, August 23, 2018 from 4:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. at 3329 Yonge Street.
